decisions.decision: Run each skill's worked example on a different real company
decisions.rationale: Variety was assumed to show range across industries

decisions.decision: Ship skills as complete folders; the owner runs every commit and push
decisions.rationale: Half-built folders read worse than absent ones, and authorship stays with the human

decisions.decision: Reframe the repo around GTM systems rather than content production
decisions.rationale: Application-tracker analysis: the target roles ask for pipelines, scoring, and automation far more than content output

decisions.decision: Consolidate all worked examples on Cohere; retire Linear, keep Notion as the generality check
decisions.rationale: Depth on one spine compounds: each skill's example feeds the next; scattered examples prove nothing twice

decisions.decision: Resequence the roadmap: account-sourcing before outbound-engine
decisions.rationale: First-90-days research: the target-account list is the first deliverable the role is hired for; sequences without a sourced list build days 61-90 before days 1-30

decisions.decision: Raise the shipping cadence to 2-3 skills per week
decisions.rationale: The pattern was proven at one per week; the remaining skills reuse established machinery

decisions.decision: Pause new skills for a hiring-manager review pass and front-door rewrite
decisions.rationale: A six-persona review found the interior over-delivering and the front door underselling; fixing conversion beats adding inventory

decisions.decision: Resume the roadmap; distribution work queued behind completion
decisions.rationale: Two skills remain; a complete table is the stronger artifact to distribute
